steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Measure salt, spices, oil; get a pan ready.

steps.label: Quick brine
steps.detail: Submerge the breasts in salted water 15 min, then pat very dry.

steps.label: Pound even
steps.detail: Pound the thick end so each breast is an even thickness.

steps.label: Season & sear
steps.detail: Rub with oil and spices; sear 3-4 min until golden.

steps.label: Flip & steam
steps.detail: Flip, cover, low heat 6-8 min to 74C.

steps.label: Rest & slice
steps.detail: Rest 5 min, slice against the grain, finish with lemon.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Pat shrimp dry, slice garlic, wash greens.

steps.label: Bloom garlic
steps.detail: Warm oil, garlic, and chili until fragrant, 1 min.

steps.label: Wilt greens
steps.detail: Add greens with a pinch of salt; toss until just wilted.

steps.label: Sear shrimp
steps.detail: Add shrimp in one layer; 1-2 min per side until opaque.

steps.label: Lemon & toss
steps.detail: Squeeze lemon, toss together, taste for salt.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Dice pepper, slice mushrooms, measure whites.

steps.label: Soften veg
steps.detail: Saute pepper and mushroom 3-4 min; wilt in spinach.

steps.label: Add whites
steps.detail: Lower heat, pour in seasoned whites, let set 20 sec.

steps.label: Fold gently
steps.detail: Push edges to center in big folds until just set.

steps.label: Plate
steps.detail: Pull while glossy; season and serve.

steps.label: Preheat oven 220C
steps.detail: Get the oven fully hot before the tomatoes go in.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Pat cod dry and season; halve tomatoes, smash garlic.

steps.label: Roast tomatoes
steps.detail: Toss tomatoes, garlic, oil, chili; roast 12 min until bursting.

steps.label: Nestle the cod
steps.detail: Season fillets, nestle into the tomatoes, spoon juices over.

steps.label: Bake the fish
steps.detail: Roast 10-12 min until the cod flakes at 60C.

steps.label: Lemon & herbs
steps.detail: Squeeze lemon, scatter herbs, serve with pan juices.

steps.label: Preheat oven 200C
steps.detail: Heat oven and line a tray (a rack helps).

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Finely chop spinach, mince garlic, measure seasoning.

steps.label: Mix the meat
steps.detail: Combine turkey, egg, spinach, garlic, oats, seasoning; don't overwork.

steps.label: Roll balls
steps.detail: Form ~16 even balls with damp hands.

steps.label: Bake
steps.detail: Bake 18-20 min until 74C and golden.

steps.label: Rest & serve
steps.detail: Rest 2 min; serve with marinara, greens, or grains.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Drain tuna, rinse beans, dice onion, chop parsley.

steps.label: Whisk dressing
steps.detail: Whisk lemon, oil, salt, pepper in a bowl.

steps.label: Mellow onion
steps.detail: Stir diced onion into the dressing; let it mellow 5 min.

steps.label: Fold it together
steps.detail: Fold in beans, flaked tuna, and parsley.

steps.label: Taste & serve
steps.detail: Adjust lemon and salt; eat as-is or over greens.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Rinse quinoa, cube chicken, gather toppings.

steps.label: Simmer quinoa
steps.detail: Simmer quinoa in water, covered, ~15 min; rest off heat.

steps.label: Sear chicken
steps.detail: Toss chicken with cumin and salt; sear 6-8 min to 74C.

steps.label: Prep the veg
steps.detail: Dice cucumber and halve tomatoes while things cook.

steps.label: Whisk tahini sauce
steps.detail: Stir tahini, lemon, and water into a drizzle.

steps.label: Build the bowls
steps.detail: Bowl quinoa, greens, veg, and chicken; drizzle sauce.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Press and cube tofu, grate ginger, prep veg.

steps.label: Mix the sauce
steps.detail: Stir tamari, vinegar, sesame oil, and cornstarch slurry.

steps.label: Crisp the tofu
steps.detail: Sear cubed tofu until golden on most sides; remove.

steps.label: Stir-fry veg
steps.detail: Toss veg and edamame over high heat 3-4 min.

steps.label: Add aromatics & sauce
steps.detail: Ginger and garlic 30 sec, then the sauce to thicken.

steps.label: Toss & serve
steps.detail: Return tofu; toss until glossy and coated.

steps.label: Preheat oven 220C
steps.detail: Get the oven fully hot.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Season chicken, trim asparagus, smash garlic, slice lemon.

steps.label: Roast chicken
steps.detail: Tray the chicken with oil, garlic, paprika; roast 15 min.

steps.label: Add asparagus
steps.detail: Add spears and lemon slices to the tray.

steps.label: Roast asparagus
steps.detail: Roast 8-10 min more until chicken is 74C and spears tender-crisp.

steps.label: Squeeze & serve
steps.detail: Squeeze the roasted lemon over everything and serve.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Julienne ginger, slice scallions, set up the steamer plate.

steps.label: Heat the steamer
steps.detail: Bring 2cm water to a simmer with a rack or plate.

steps.label: Steam the fish
steps.detail: Steam fish with half the ginger 7-9 min until it flakes.

steps.label: Warm the sauce
steps.detail: Warm tamari with sugar and a splash of steaming water; pour over.

steps.label: Sizzle aromatics
steps.detail: Top with scallion and ginger; pour over smoking-hot oil.

steps.label: Garnish & serve
steps.detail: Finish with cilantro and white pepper.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Dice onion, mince garlic, separate lettuce, ready toppings.

steps.label: Soften aromatics
steps.detail: Cook onion 3 min; add garlic and spices 30 sec.

steps.label: Brown the turkey
steps.detail: Add turkey; break up and cook until no longer pink.

steps.label: Saucy finish
steps.detail: Add a splash of water and salt; simmer 3-4 min until glossy.

steps.label: Build the cups
steps.detail: Spoon into lettuce cups; top with lime, cilantro, salsa.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Dice cucumber and halve the tomatoes.

steps.label: Season the base
steps.detail: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl; season with salt and pepper.

steps.label: Add toppings
steps.detail: Pile on cucumber and tomato.

steps.label: Drizzle & serve
steps.detail: Drizzle oil and lemon; scatter herbs and chili flakes.

steps.label: Sort & rinse the beans
steps.detail: Pick out stones on a sheet pan, then rinse until the water runs clear.

steps.label: Saute onion, garlic & spices
steps.detail: Soften the onion in oil 4-5 min, then bloom garlic, cumin, and oregano 30 sec.

steps.label: Add beans, water & salt
steps.detail: Stir in beans, 6 cups water, bay leaf, and salt, scraping the bottom clean.

steps.label: Come to pressure
steps.detail: Lid sealed, a full pot of cold water takes about 12 min to pressurize.

steps.label: Pressure cook 30 min
steps.detail: High pressure for 30 min, or 35 if you want them soft enough to mash.

steps.label: Natural release 20 min
steps.detail: Leave the valve alone for 20 min so the bean foam settles.

steps.label: Vent the rest
steps.detail: Release any residual pressure, then open the lid away from you.

steps.label: Lime, salt & rest
steps.detail: Pull the bay leaf, stir in lime, taste for salt, rest 5 min in the liquid.

steps.label: Sort & rinse the chickpeas
steps.detail: Check for stones and rinse in a colander until the water runs clear.

steps.label: Load pot with water & soda
steps.detail: Chickpeas, 8 cups water, 1 tsp baking soda, salt; keep the level at or below half.

steps.label: Come to pressure
steps.detail: Eight cups of cold water takes roughly 13 min to reach high pressure.

steps.label: Pressure cook 45 min
steps.detail: High pressure 45 min for hummus-soft chickpeas, 35 min if you want them intact.

steps.label: Natural release 20 min
steps.detail: No quick release here - soda-foamed chickpea water goes straight out the valve.

steps.label: Drain & save the aquafaba
steps.detail: Drain over a bowl, keeping at least 2 cups of cooking liquid; skim loose skins.

steps.label: Blend the hummus
steps.detail: Whip tahini and lemon first, add warm chickpeas, then liquid and an ice cube.

steps.label: Rinse & drain the rice
steps.detail: Three or four changes of cold water until clear, then drain hard.

steps.label: Load 1:1 rice and water
steps.detail: Rice, 2 cups water, salt, optional oil; shake the pot flat to level it.

steps.label: Come to pressure
steps.detail: This volume pressurizes in about 7 min before the cook timer starts.

steps.label: Pressure cook 4 min
steps.detail: High pressure: 3 min for basmati, 4 for jasmine, 5 for stickier grains.

steps.label: Natural release 10 min
steps.detail: Walk away for 10 min; venting early tears the grains open.

steps.label: Quick release the rest
steps.detail: Flip the valve to release residual pressure and open the lid.

steps.label: Fluff & rest uncovered
steps.detail: Fork from the edges inward, then leave the lid off 3 min to steam off.

steps.label: Rinse & drain the rice
steps.detail: Two changes of cold water, then drain thoroughly so the ratio holds.

steps.label: Load 2 cups rice, 2.5 water
steps.detail: Add salt and optional oil, stir once, and shake the bed flat.

steps.label: Come to pressure
steps.detail: About 8 min to pressurize; the 22-minute display starts after that.

steps.label: Pressure cook 22 min
steps.detail: High pressure: 20 min for brown basmati, 24 for short-grain brown.

steps.label: Natural release 10 min
steps.detail: Bran foams hard, so give it a full 10 min untouched.

steps.label: Quick release the rest
steps.detail: Vent residual pressure through the valve and open the lid.

steps.label: Fluff with a fork
steps.detail: Lift from the edges toward the center instead of stirring.

steps.label: Rest uncovered 3 min
steps.detail: Lid off so surface moisture steams away and the grains firm up.

steps.label: Measure oats, water & salt
steps.detail: Get 2 cups oats, 6 cups water, oil, salt, and cinnamon on the counter.

steps.label: Toast the oats in fat
steps.detail: On Saute, stir the dry oats in melted oil 3-4 min until they smell nutty.

steps.label: Add water & scrape the base
steps.detail: Pour in 6 cups water, scrape up every toasted bit, add salt and cinnamon.

steps.label: Come to pressure
steps.detail: Eight cups of volume takes about 10 min to reach high pressure.

steps.label: Pressure cook 4 min
steps.detail: High pressure: 3 min for chewy oats, 6 min for soft porridge.

steps.label: Natural release 15 min
steps.detail: Never vent oats early - the foam sprays hot starch out of the valve.

steps.label: Release any residual pressure
steps.detail: Flip the valve, wait for the float to drop, and open the lid.

steps.label: Stir it together
steps.detail: It looks watery on top; 30 sec of stirring pulls it into porridge.

steps.label: Portion into six containers
steps.detail: Divide while hot and leave the toppings off until serving.

steps.label: Mise en place & rub
steps.detail: Cut the shoulder into 4 chunks and press the spice rub onto every face.

steps.label: Sear the pork in batches
steps.detail: Saute High, two chunks at a time, 3-4 min a side until deeply browned.

steps.label: Onion & deglaze the base
steps.detail: Soften the onion, add broth and vinegar, and scrape the base completely clean.

steps.label: Come to pressure
steps.detail: A full pot of meat and liquid takes roughly 15 min before the cook timer starts.

steps.label: Pressure cook 55 min
steps.detail: High Pressure 55 min turns the collagen in the shoulder chunks to gelatin.

steps.label: Natural release 20 min
steps.detail: Leave the valve alone for 20 min so the meat re-absorbs its juices instead of seizing.

steps.label: Quick release the remainder
steps.detail: Flip the valve to vent whatever pressure is left, then open the lid away from you.

steps.label: Shred the pork
steps.detail: Pull the chunks apart with two forks, discarding the thick fat seams.

steps.label: Reduce the cooking liquid
steps.detail: Saute High and boil the liquid down by about half, 8-10 min.

steps.label: Skim & dress the pork
steps.detail: Skim the fat, then pour 1 to 1 1/2 cups of the reduced liquid back over the shreds.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Cut the chuck into 3 pieces, halve the potatoes, cut the carrots, slice the onion.

steps.label: Sear the chuck
steps.detail: Saute High, one or two pieces at a time, about 4 min a side until dark.

steps.label: Aromatics & deglaze
steps.detail: Soften onion and garlic 3 min, add broth and tamari, scrape the base clean.

steps.label: Come to pressure
steps.detail: About 13 min with 3 lb of beef and 2 cups of liquid in the pot.

steps.label: Pressure cook the beef 45 min
steps.detail: High Pressure 45 min for chuck cut into three thick pieces.

steps.label: Natural release 15 min
steps.detail: Let the pressure fall on its own, then vent the remainder.

steps.label: Add potatoes & carrots
steps.detail: Tuck the vegetables into the liquid around the beef; stay under the 2/3 line.

steps.label: Come back to pressure
steps.detail: About 8 min the second time, since the liquid is already hot.

steps.label: Pressure cook the vegetables 5 min
steps.detail: High Pressure 5 min, then quick release immediately or they turn to mush.

steps.label: Quick release & thicken the gravy
steps.detail: Vent, lift everything out, skim, then Saute and whisk in the cornstarch slurry.

steps.label: Dry, season & truss
steps.detail: Pat the bird bone-dry, rub it inside and out, stuff the lemon and garlic, tie the legs.

steps.label: Sear breast-side down
steps.detail: Saute High, breast down and undisturbed 5-6 min, then 2 min on the back.

steps.label: Deglaze & set the trivet
steps.detail: Broth in, scrape the base clean, then trivet in and the chicken breast-side up on it.

steps.label: Come to pressure
steps.detail: Roughly 12 min with a whole bird and 1 cup of broth in the pot.

steps.label: Pressure cook 25 min (6 min per pound)
steps.detail: High Pressure 25 min for a 4 lb bird, 30 min for 5 lb.

steps.label: Natural release 15 min
steps.detail: A quick release here squeezes juice straight out of the breast; wait it out.

steps.label: Lift out & check 74C
steps.detail: Thickest part of the thigh should read 74C; 5 more min at pressure if not.

steps.label: Broil to crisp the skin
steps.detail: 5-7 min under a hot broiler until the skin browns and tightens.

steps.label: Rest 10 min
steps.detail: Rest the bird on the tray before carving so the juices settle.

steps.label: Carve & strain the jus
steps.detail: Carve the bird and strain the pot liquid for a light jus or stock.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Measure the spices and broth; separate the breasts if they are frozen together.

steps.label: Bloom the spices on Saute
steps.detail: Oil in, then cumin, paprika and garlic powder for 45 sec until toasted.

steps.label: Broth in, scrape the base
steps.detail: Pour the broth in fast and scrape before the spices scorch onto the base.

steps.label: Come to pressure
steps.detail: About 10 min, and longer if the chicken went in frozen.

steps.label: Pressure cook: 10 min fresh, 15 min frozen
steps.detail: High Pressure; add 5 min for thighs instead of breasts.

steps.label: Natural release 10 min
steps.detail: Lean breast turns stringy on a fast release, so give it the full 10 min.

steps.label: Quick release
steps.detail: Vent the remaining pressure and open the lid away from you.

steps.label: Check 74C & shred
steps.detail: Confirm the thickest breast reads 74C, then shred with two forks.

steps.label: Reduce & moisten the shreds
steps.detail: Saute the liquid down to about 1 cup, then stir it back through with the lime.

steps.label: Membrane off, rub on
steps.detail: Peel the silverskin off the bone side, rub both faces, cut the rack in half.

steps.label: Liquid, trivet, ribs on edge
steps.detail: Water and vinegar under the trivet, then stand the rib halves curled around the wall.

steps.label: Come to pressure
steps.detail: About 12 min with a full rack and 1 cup of liquid.

steps.label: Pressure cook 25 min
steps.detail: High Pressure 25 min for fall-off-the-bone, 20 min if you want some chew.

steps.label: Natural release 15 min
steps.detail: Full natural release stops the meat tightening back onto the bones.

steps.label: Preheat the broiler
steps.detail: Start the broiler while the pot is releasing so it is hot when the ribs come out.

steps.label: Quick release
steps.detail: Vent the remaining pressure and lift the racks out carefully; they are fragile.

steps.label: Sauce the racks
steps.detail: Ribs meat side up on a foil-lined tray, brushed with a thick coat of sauce.

steps.label: Broil 5-7 min to set the glaze
steps.detail: 6 inches from the element until the sauce bubbles and darkens; do not walk away.

steps.label: Rest & cut between the bones
steps.detail: Rest 5 min, then cut meat side down so you can see the bones.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Dice onion and pepper, mince garlic, rinse the beans, measure the spices.

steps.label: Brown the beef on Saute
steps.detail: Break the beef into the hot dry pot and brown 8 min, then pour off most of the fat.

steps.label: Onion, pepper, spices, tomato paste
steps.detail: Cook the vegetables 4 min, then toast garlic, spices, and paste 1 min.

steps.label: Deglaze until the bottom is clean
steps.detail: Add the broth and scrape every stuck patch loose or you will get a burn notice.

steps.label: Layer beans and tomatoes, do not stir
steps.detail: Scatter the beans over the meat and float the crushed tomatoes on top unstirred.

steps.label: Come to pressure
steps.detail: Lid on and sealed; a full pot takes about 12 min before the timer starts.

steps.label: High Pressure 15 min
steps.detail: Cook at high pressure for 15 minutes.

steps.label: Natural release 10 min, then vent
steps.detail: Let it drop on its own 10 min so the chili does not spit through the valve.

steps.label: Stir and thicken on Saute
steps.detail: Stir it together, simmer 5 min uncovered if loose, then season with salt and acid.

steps.label: Rinse lentils and prep aromatics
steps.detail: Rinse the lentils until the water runs clear; dice onion, grate ginger, mince garlic.

steps.label: Saute onion, ginger, garlic, spices
steps.detail: Onion 4 min, then ginger and garlic 1 min, then turmeric and coriander 30 sec.

steps.label: Tomatoes, then deglaze the base
steps.detail: Break the tomatoes down with a splash of water while scraping the pot clean.

steps.label: Add lentils, water, salt
steps.detail: Stir once so nothing sits dry on the bottom, then lid on and valve sealed.

steps.label: Come to pressure
steps.detail: Roughly 10 min for four cups of water plus lentils to build pressure.

steps.label: High Pressure 5 min
steps.detail: Cook at high pressure for 5 minutes.

steps.label: Full natural release 15 min
steps.detail: Do not touch the valve; foaming dal sprays starch through a quick release.

steps.label: Fry the tadka
steps.detail: Pop cumin seeds in hot oil, add chilies and asafoetida, chili powder off the heat.

steps.label: Whisk smooth and pour the tadka over
steps.detail: Thin with hot water, add the tadka, lemon, and cilantro, then taste for salt.

steps.label: Break down bones, chunk the vegetables
steps.detail: Pack the bones flat and cut onion, carrot, and celery into big pieces.

steps.label: Brown the bones on Saute
steps.detail: Two batches, 4 min each, until the bones take real color.

steps.label: Deglaze the fond
steps.detail: Add a cup of water and scrape the base completely clean, then cancel Saute.

steps.label: Fill to the 2/3 line, no further
steps.detail: Add vegetables and aromatics, then cold water only up to the 2/3 max line.

steps.label: Come to pressure
steps.detail: About 15 min for a pot this full of cold water to seal and build pressure.

steps.label: High Pressure 45 min
steps.detail: Cook at high pressure for 45 minutes.

steps.label: Full natural release 20 min
steps.detail: Never vent hot fatty stock; wait for the float valve to drop by itself.

steps.label: Strain through a lined sieve
steps.detail: Ladle through damp cloth and let it drip; pressing the solids clouds the stock.

steps.label: Cool fast in shallow containers
steps.detail: Ice bath or shallow trays to get it under 5C, then chill and lift off the fat cap.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Dice the mirepoix, mince garlic, pat the thighs dry, measure the stock.

steps.label: Brown thighs skin-side down
steps.detail: Six minutes undisturbed on Saute High until the skin releases, then remove.

steps.label: Sweat onion, carrot, celery
steps.detail: Five minutes in the rendered fat, then garlic and thyme for 30 sec.

steps.label: Deglaze with a cup of stock
steps.detail: Scrape the fond loose until the spoon glides, then cancel Saute.

steps.label: Come to pressure
steps.detail: Two liters of cold liquid takes about 12 min to reach high pressure.

steps.label: High Pressure 12 min
steps.detail: Cook the thighs at high pressure for 12 minutes.

steps.label: Natural release 10 min, then vent
steps.detail: A pot this full sputters broth if you crack the valve hot.

steps.label: Shred the chicken
steps.detail: Pull the thighs out, shred with two forks, discard bones, skin, and bay.

steps.label: Noodles on Saute 6-8 min
steps.detail: Simmer the noodles in the broth to just short of tender; they keep softening.

steps.label: Return chicken, lemon and dill
steps.detail: Off the heat, stir the chicken back in and salt harder than feels right.

steps.label: Mince shallot, grate cheese, heat stock
steps.detail: Everything ready before you start; the finish is under five minutes.

steps.label: Sweat the shallot on Saute
steps.detail: Three minutes in oil and butter until soft with no color.

steps.label: Toast the rice
steps.detail: Stir the dry rice 2-3 min until the edges go translucent and it smells nutty.

steps.label: Deglaze with white wine
steps.detail: Stir until nearly evaporated, scraping the base clean so rice cannot scorch.

steps.label: Add hot stock and level the rice
steps.detail: Stir once, level it so no grains sit above the liquid, lid on and sealed.

steps.label: Come to pressure
steps.detail: Hot stock and a small volume bring it up in roughly 8 min.

steps.label: High Pressure 6 min
steps.detail: Exactly 6 minutes at high pressure; longer turns it to porridge.

steps.label: Quick release immediately
steps.detail: Vent the moment the timer sounds, standing clear of the valve.

steps.label: Beat in butter and Parmigiano
steps.detail: Off the heat, beat hard for a full minute until it turns glossy, then serve.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Get out 12 cold eggs, the trivet, and a large bowl for the ice bath.

steps.label: Load water, trivet, eggs
steps.detail: Pour in 1 cup cold water, set the trivet, stack the eggs on top.

steps.label: Build the ice bath
steps.detail: Fill a large bowl with ice and cold water and set it beside the pot.

steps.label: Come to pressure
steps.detail: Lid on, valve Sealing; the pot needs about 6 min to seal and pressurize.

steps.label: High pressure 5 min
steps.detail: Cook the eggs 5 min at high pressure.

steps.label: Natural release 5 min
steps.detail: Leave the pot completely alone for exactly 5 min.

steps.label: Quick release the rest
steps.detail: Move the valve to Venting and open once the pin drops.

steps.label: Ice bath 5 min
steps.detail: Tongs the eggs straight into the ice water and leave them 5 min.

steps.label: Peel
steps.detail: Crack the fat end, roll the egg under your palm, peel under cold water.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Get out 2 L milk, the starter, and an instant-read thermometer.

steps.label: Wash and dry the pot
steps.detail: Clean the inner pot, lid, and sealing ring so nothing competes with the culture.

steps.label: Scald the milk to 82C
steps.detail: Press Yogurt and adjust to Boil; stir the bottom now and then so it does not scorch.

steps.label: Cool to 43C
steps.detail: Lift the inner pot out and let it drop to 43C; above 46C kills the culture.

steps.label: Temper in the starter
steps.detail: Whisk 2 tbsp yogurt into a cup of warm milk, then stir it back into the pot.

steps.label: Incubate 8 hours on Yogurt
steps.detail: Lid on, press Yogurt, set 8:00. No pressure involved; do not stir or peek.

steps.label: Chill 6 hours
steps.detail: Refrigerate undisturbed; it firms up considerably as it cools.

steps.label: Jar it and save starter
steps.detail: Spoon into clean jars and set aside 2 tbsp to start the next batch.

steps.label: Peel and cut the potatoes
steps.detail: Peel 1.4 kg Yukon Golds and cut them into even 5cm chunks.

steps.label: Load pot: potatoes, 1 cup liquid
steps.detail: Potatoes straight into the water or stock with 1 tsp salt, no trivet.

steps.label: Warm the butter and milk
steps.detail: Heat 85g butter with 180ml milk 60-90 sec; cold dairy makes the mash gluey.

steps.label: Come to pressure
steps.detail: Lid on, valve Sealing; about 9 min before the cook time starts.

steps.label: High pressure 8 min
steps.detail: Cook the potato chunks 8 min at high pressure.

steps.label: Quick release
steps.detail: Valve to Venting the moment it beeps so they do not overcook.

steps.label: Drain the excess liquid
steps.detail: Tip off standing liquid but keep a few tablespoons in reserve.

steps.label: Mash in the pot
steps.detail: Add the warm butter and milk and mash by hand; never a stick blender.

steps.label: Season and taste
steps.detail: Salt hard, then white pepper, then taste again before serving.

steps.label: Cut everything to one size
steps.detail: Cut 700g of vegetables so the whole basket finishes at the same moment.

steps.label: Load water, basket, vegetables
steps.detail: 1 cup cold water in the pot, basket in, vegetables above the water line.

steps.label: Come to pressure
steps.detail: Lid on, valve Sealing; roughly 5 min before the count starts.

steps.label: High pressure 0-3 min
steps.detail: Florets 0 min, green beans 1 min, carrots and sprouts 2-3 min.

steps.label: Instant quick release
steps.detail: Valve to Venting the second it beeps; 30 seconds of delay is a doneness level.

steps.label: Lift the basket out
steps.detail: Get the vegetables onto a plate immediately, away from the residual heat.

steps.label: Dress while hot
steps.detail: Salt, olive oil, and a squeeze of lemon while they are still steaming.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Measure everything, fold a foil sling, and set the trivet in the pot.

steps.label: Cream cheese and eggs to room temp
steps.detail: A full hour on the counter; cold cream cheese never beats smooth.

steps.label: Press and freeze the crust
steps.detail: Press crumbs, sugar, and butter into the pan, then freeze it 10 min.

steps.label: Beat the batter
steps.detail: Cream cheese and sugar smooth, then cornstarch, vanilla, sour cream, eggs on lowest speed.

steps.label: Fill and cover with foil
steps.detail: Pour in, rap out the bubbles, cover tightly so condensation cannot drip.

steps.label: Come to pressure
steps.detail: Pan onto the trivet over 1 1/2 cups water; about 10 min to pressurize.

steps.label: High pressure 37 min
steps.detail: Steam the cheesecake 37 min; the center should still wobble as one piece.

steps.label: Full natural release
steps.detail: Do not touch the valve; about 20 min until the pin drops. This prevents cracks.

steps.label: Blot and cool 1 hour
steps.detail: Blot the surface dry with a paper towel and cool on the counter.

steps.label: Chill 6 hours
steps.detail: Refrigerate at least 6 hours, overnight if you can; it is a different dessert cold.
